internalTitle.en-US: Careers "Everything You Need" Grid Item - What we value

content.value: Innovation. Determination. Imagination. Respect. These are the value our humans live and breathe each day – and it’s what we look for in each Workhuman candidate.

internalName.en-US: Content Block - Everything You Need Grid

internalTitle.en-US: Role - Technology - Architecture

content.value: Our architecture team leads our company as we scale, and maximizes the value we get from our technologies to offer ground-breaking new services and stellar experiences for our users. The team synthesizes business strategy, outcomes, capabilities, and processes to allow us to continue on our exciting company trajectory upward.

internalTitle.en-US: Role - Technology - IT Infrastructure

content.value: This team delivers innovative and scalable solutions to maintain and elevate our cloud and corporate IT infrastructures by providing top-level support and service – and by staying at the forefront of security best practices and new technological advancements.

internalTitle.en-US: Role - Technology - Engineering

content.value: Our engineering team works functionally to design and build products our customers love
. They strive for better, taking full advantage of the breadth of technologies AWS offers to build world-class product capabilities.

internalTitle.en-US: Role - Sales - Sales Executives

content.value: Our sales executives manage complex sales cycles to deliver maximum revenue potential, all the while inspiring other companies to do their life’s best work. Evangelizing the Workhuman vision and value through product demos, in-market events, and account-specific initiatives, our sales executives are vital ambassadors of a more human workplace to the market.

internalTitle.en-US: Role - Sales - Sales Operations

content.value: Our sales operations team provides support to the sales organization in everything from proposal writing to vendor management. This team has a passion for operations and customer support and demonstrates strong organizational, communication and time management skills.

internalTitle.en-US: Role - Product - Product Strategy

content.value: Led from the U.S. and working closely with our clients and product strategy team members based in Ireland, this team shapes the strategy and thought leadership of making work more human. They are the creative force behind our products’ user experience and they partner with development to bring that vision to reality.

internalTitle.en-US: Role - Product - Product Management

content.value: Our customer strategy team works alongside our customers to build and maintain relationships with their executive leaders and decision makers at top-tier strategic accounts.

internalTitle.en-US: Role - Product - Product Design

content.value: Our product design team takes a human-centered approach to create world-class product experiences for our users. Our Human UX Framework is firmly rooted in the design-thinking methodology, which is leveraged to more deeply understand user behavior and motivations, and to deliver experiences that satisfy both the individual user and the business needs.

internalTitle.en-US: Role - Product - WHiQ and Business Analytics

content.value: Our team of psychologists, researchers, data scientists, linguists, programmers and engineers study tens of millions of data points on how people work to develop AI and science‒based recommendations to deepen human connections. With the insights uncovered we can ensure that we consistently make an informed impact for our customers and their employees.

internalTitle.en-US: Role - Operations - Customer Service

content.value: At Workhuman, our customers are at the heart of what we do. Our dedicated customer service team goes out of their way to deliver an award-winning, world-class customer service experience.

internalTitle.en-US: Role - Operations - Back Office Solutions

content.value: Behind the scenes but always at the heart of it all. Our Back Office team keeps Workhuman running smoothly—managing finance, legal, compliance, and internal operations with care, precision, and a human touch.

internalTitle.en-US: Role - Operations - Partner Management

content.value: Supplier relationship management onboard and develop the relationships of our third-party suppliers. They ensure we select and develop scalable, cost-effective and best in class suppliers while minimizing risk to our business.

internalTitle.en-US: Role - Operations - Global Supply Chain

content.value: Supply chain is dedicated to delivering an exceptional experience to our customers in over 170 countries. Teams focus on order management, logistics, demand planning, inventory management, reverse logistics and business insights.

internalTitle.en-US: Role - Operations - Inventory Procurement and Vendor Management

content.value: From sourcing to shipping, this team makes the magic happen behind every meaningful moment. We manage the flow of goods, build strong partnerships with vendors, and ensure the right rewards get to the right people—on time, every time.

internalTitle.en-US: Role - Marketing - Creative Services and Corporate Marketing

content.value: This team consists of innovative creative directors, designers, and producers who breathe life into everything we put out into the marketplace and make us look like a billion bucks while they’re at it.

internalTitle.en-US: Role - Marketing - Demand Gen & Customer Marketing

content.value: This team helps us stand out in the market and build the foundation for who we are to our customers and beyond, driving campaigns to generate demand and elicit sales leads.

internalTitle.en-US: Role - Marketing - Product Marketing

content.value: Do you have a real passion for provocative messaging that drives business forward? Want to help us really stand out in the marketplace? Join our team of go-to-market, comp analysis, and sales enablement experts.

internalTitle.en-US: Role - Marketing - Global Events

content.value: This team is responsible for our entire portfolio of events – both internal and external. No detail is too small to ensure our events are powerful, game-changing experiences. Ever heard of Workhuman
Live? That’s our jam.

internalTitle.en-US: Role - Marketing - Content and Communications

content.value: Weaving the story of what we do in a way that drives talent, business goals, and recognition for us and our customers is the name of the game for our writers, social media experts, relationship-builders, PR talents, and content creators.

internalTitle.en-US: Role - Marketing - Business Development

content.value: Business development representatives play a vital role in maximizing the attainment of the company’s new business and revenue goals. They’re at the forefront of the sales team generating, as well as qualifying, all leads including inbound, marketing driven leads as well as those generated from cold calling.

internalTitle.en-US: Role - Legal

content.value: From customer contract negotiations to vendor partnerships, our legal team ensures accountability and transparency, safeguarding our operations and infrastructure as we scale.

internalTitle.en-US: Role - Finance

content.value: Our finance team is comprised of decisive and strategic financial advisors and support staff, backing us as we scale, maintaining growth and competitive advantage for our company at the line-item level.

internalTitle.en-US: Role - E-Commerce - Client Engagement

content.value: Our clients and their employees are at the heart of everything we do at Workhuman. Our client engagement team develops the connection between our client needs and our e-Commerce strategy and roadmap, and evangelizes and markets our e-Commerce vision to enable the growth and scale of our client base.

internalTitle.en-US: Role - E-Commerce - Global Category Management

content.value: Our category management team develops our assortment strategy to optimize and expand our offering across 180+ countries across the globe. Through multi-tiered country and category plans, this group sources and manages our suppliers and optimizes our catalog to promote rapid growth, scalability, and the delivery of an outstanding user experience all over the world.

internalTitle.en-US: Role - E-Commerce - Store Experience

content.value: Delivering an immersive, dynamic experience on a global scale requires incredible innovation, creativity, and analytical sophistication. This team owns and drives the vision for our store and how we expand our features, functionality, and curation to deliver an inspiring user experience. From promotions and creative to multi-channel user engagement strategies, the store experience team brings our offering to life to enhance the user journey.

internalTitle.en-US: Role - Customer Excellence - Workhuman Consulting Practice

content.value: We turn insight into action. Our Consulting Practice partners with clients to design and optimize recognition strategies rooted in data, behavioral science, and decades of expertise. From kickoff to impact, we help organizations build more human workplaces—where people feel seen, valued, and empowered to thrive.

internalTitle.en-US: Role - Customer Excellence - Launch Success

content.value: Our launch success team works directly with customers to ensure they are led through the program goals definition, program design, configuration and adoption phases successfully in order to position the customer for success.

internalTitle.en-US: Role - Customer Excellence - Customer and Launch Success

content.value: This team works cross-functionally to ensure the overall customer experience with Workhuman is one full of pleasant surprise and delight. They are committed to working as primary points of contact throughout the customer’s lifecycle, ensuring they receive maximum value from our solution.

internalTitle.en-US: Role - Human Experience (HX) - Talent Acquisition and Talent Brand

content.value: Our talent acquisition and talent brand team make it their mission to bring the right humans on board, facilitating our growth with people aligned with our vision of bringing more humanity to work.

internalTitle.en-US: Role - Human Experience (HX) - Talent Development

content.value: This team supports our growth by creating learning and development programs that reflect our culture and reinforce our values. They drive our broader talent strategy, defining the priorities in partnership with the business and designing and delivering programs that support our business objectives.

internalTitle.en-US: Role - Human Experience (HX) - DEI & ESG

content.value: This team elevates Workhuman’s social impact by supporting communities, DE&I, healthcare, and the environment with the knowledge that when people feel valued, respected, and seen, that their sense of self-worth, mental health, and social well-being have limitless potential.

internalTitle.en-US: Role - Human Experience (HX) - People, Places and Systems

content.value: This team manages the structures, facilities, and technological capabilities of our workforce. They empower us to do our best work by giving us the tools we need, and the employee experience we deserve – wherever we are in the world.

internalTitle.en-US: Role - Customer Excellence - Go To Market Operations

content.value: We’re the engine behind sales, marketing, and customer success. Go-to-Market Operations brings strategy to life—driving alignment, insights, and efficiency across every stage of the customer journey. We power growth by connecting teams, streamlining processes, and making sure great ideas reach the right people at the right time.

internalTitle.en-US: Paycheck Grid Item Technology - Be yourself

content.value: We practice what we preach. Great work is recognized, and humans are at the center of how we operate. We want you to be inspired to do your best work – and to live your best life.

internalTitle.en-US: Paycheck Grid Item Technology - Influence

content.value: Our technology center in Dublin brings together teams who make all our technical and design decisions. You’ll be at the heart of the action here, surrounded by a world-class team to learn and grow with.

internalTitle.en-US: Paycheck Grid Item Technology - Innovate

content.value: Innovation is a core value at Workhuman – we build it into our everyday thinking, make space every sprint for engineering-led focus Fridays, and collaborate company-wide in Hackathon-style events to continuously enhance our platform and user experience.

internalTitle.en-US: Paycheck Grid Item Technology - Experiment

content.value: We’re continuously trying out ways to improve. When it comes to doing things better, employees of every career level are encouraged to have a voice.

internalTitle.en-US: Paycheck Grid Item Technology - Have an impact

content.value: You’ll be working on products that benefit the lives of and make work more human for more than 5 million users around the world.

internalTitle.en-US: Paycheck Grid Item Multiple Teams - Global reach

content.value: Our e-commerce team is committed to delivering a personalized store experience to more than seven million users in 180+ countries around the world.

internalTitle.en-US: Paycheck Grid Item Multiple Teams - Diverse & inclusive vendor portfolio

content.value: Curate the rewards redemption experience for employees of some of the most well-known brands in the world, including Dell, Intuit, Eaton, Cisco, LinkedIn, Bristol Meyers Squibb, and more.

internalTitle.en-US: Paycheck Grid Item Multiple Teams - Work/life balance

content.value: At Workhuman, we get it. And we pride ourselves in offering a supportive and flexible environment so you can balance the work you do with the life you live.

internalTitle.en-US: Paycheck Grid Item Multiple Teams - Data has your back

content.value: Data backs up the value of our product and empowers you to deliver the solutions that meet the needs of your prospects and ultimately win deals.

internalTitle.en-US: Paycheck Grid Item Multiple Teams - Top-notch clients

content.value: Maximize our product value for some of the most well-known brands in the world, including Dell, Intuit, Eaton, Cisco, LinkedIn, Bristol Meyers Squibb, and more.

internalTitle.en-US: Paycheck Grid Item Customer Excellence - Customer nurturance

content.value: We are very high touch and innovative in our customer relationships, and you are a critically important in tending those relationships as they blossom.

content.value: We encourage our operations team members to invest in their development via our Dedicated Time to Learn practice. Global Operations has a rich history in providing pathways to new careers, whether that be within Operations or across the organization.

internalTitle.en-US: Paycheck Grid Item Operations - Creativity welcome

content.value: Our humans are encouraged to have a voice and think outside of the box to deliver moments that matter. Whether it’s finding creative solutions or going above and beyond to surprise and delight, you’ll be supported in your efforts of living our values to serve customers worldwide.

internalTitle.en-US: Paycheck Grid Item Operations - Bring your culture with you

content.value: We take pride in the diversity and inclusivity our products foster, so it’s only natural we support our own employees using their native languages at work – 11 of them as of today.

internalTitle.en-US: Paycheck Grid Item HX - Recognized by others

content.value: Our HX team is extremely proud that our culture is frequently recognized for being a Great Place to Work. See more about that here.

internalTitle.en-US: Paycheck Grid Item HX - Investing in you

content.value: We value our humans which is why we invest in their professional development. From online coursework to global conference attendance or professional accreditation, expect to grow here.

internalTitle.en-US: Paycheck Grid Item HX - Humans empowering humans

content.value: Our HX team facilitates a more human workplace for our team, who in turn do the same for seven million users across 180+ countries on our platform.

internalTitle.en-US: Paycheck Grid Item HX - Super (human) users

content.value: We understand the value our products bring our customers because we experience it firsthand. It’s the norm here to use our own platform to express gratitude and celebrate important life events with one another.
